title: 341. Geometry, Spatial Thinking & Measurement: Special Right Triangles
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the relationship between the legs and the hypotenuse in a 45-45-90 triangle.
questions.question: In a \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, if each leg has length \(s\), what is the length of the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: In a \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the two legs are equal, and the hypotenuse is \(\sqrt{2}\) times the length of a leg. Therefore, if each leg has length \(s\), the hypotenuse is \(s\sqrt{2}\).
questions.hint: Recall the fixed side ratio for a 45-45-90 triangle.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the relationship between the legs in a 30-60-90 triangle.
questions.question: In a \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, if the shorter leg (opposite \(30^\circ\)) has length \(x\), what is the length of the longer leg (opposite \(60^\circ\))?
questions.explanation: In a \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the sides are in the ratio \(1:\sqrt{3}:2\). The shorter leg is \(x\), the longer leg is \(x\sqrt{3}\), and the hypotenuse is \(2x\).
questions.hint: Relate the three sides to an equilateral triangle cut by its altitude.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle given the leg length.
questions.question: A \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle has legs of length \(5\). What is the length of the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: For a \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the hypotenuse equals a leg multiplied by \(\sqrt{2}\). Thus, the hypotenuse is \(5\sqrt{2}\).

questions.concept: Leg from Hypotenuse in a 45-45-90 Triangle
questions.learningObjective: Find a leg of a 45-45-90 triangle given the hypotenuse.
questions.question: A \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle has hypotenuse \(8\sqrt{2}\). What is the length of each leg?
questions.explanation: In a \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the hypotenuse is \(\sqrt{2}\) times a leg. Therefore, the leg length is \(\frac{8\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2}}=8\).

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the shorter leg of a 30-60-90 triangle given the hypotenuse.
questions.question: A \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle has hypotenuse \(12\). What is the length of the shorter leg?
questions.explanation: In a \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the shorter leg is half the hypotenuse. Thus, the shorter leg is \(12 \div 2 = 6\).
questions.hint: The shorter leg is opposite the \(30^\circ\) angle and is half the hypotenuse.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the longer leg of a 30-60-90 triangle given the shorter leg.
questions.question: A \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle has shorter leg \(7\). What is the length of the longer leg?
questions.explanation: In a \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the longer leg is \(\sqrt{3}\) times the shorter leg. Therefore, the longer leg is \(7\sqrt{3}\).

questions.learningObjective: Use a 30-60-90 triangle to find the altitude of an equilateral triangle.
questions.question: An equilateral triangle has side length \(10\). What is the length of its altitude?
questions.explanation: The altitude of an equilateral triangle splits it into two congruent \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangles. The hypotenuse is \(10\), so the shorter leg is \(5\). The altitude is the longer leg, which is \(5\sqrt{3}\).
questions.hint: Draw the altitude to form a 30-60-90 triangle.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the diagonal of a square using the 45-45-90 triangle ratio.
questions.question: A square has side length \(6\). What is the length of its diagonal?
questions.explanation: The diagonal of a square forms a \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle with two sides. The diagonal is the hypotenuse, so its length is \(6\sqrt{2}\).

questions.concept: Hypotenuse from Long Leg in a 30-60-90 Triangle
questions.learningObjective: Determine the hypotenuse of a 30-60-90 triangle given the longer leg.
questions.question: A \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle has longer leg \(9\sqrt{3}\). What is the length of the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: In a \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the longer leg is \(\sqrt{3}\) times the shorter leg. Thus, the shorter leg is \(\frac{9\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}}=9\). The hypotenuse is twice the shorter leg, so it is \(18\).
questions.hint: First find the shorter leg by dividing the longer leg by \(\sqrt{3}\).

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the area of a 30-60-90 triangle given the hypotenuse.
questions.question: A \(30^\circ-60^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle has hypotenuse \(10\). What is its area?
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is \(10\), so the shorter leg is \(5\) and the longer leg is \(5\sqrt{3}\). The area of a triangle is \(\frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}\). Using the two legs, the area is \(\frac{1}{2}\times 5 \times 5\sqrt{3} = \frac{25\sqrt{3}}{2}\).
questions.hint: Find both legs first, then use the triangle area formula.
